perParcelTable.uniformFinding: ALL 10 P-254 FAIL parcels carry zoningProvenance/railStates of {serve:"record", atomBacked:false}. The card's district is served from the PARCEL-RECORD rail on every one of them; the atom chain is not the card's zoning source on any of them.

dispatchHypothesisTestedAndRefuted.hypothesis: The dispatch's reading: 'a stamp keyed or scoped by the city's home county, or read from a source loaded per county, while the card's ledger rail carries the district for the parcel's own county. Test that reading first; do not assume it.'
dispatchHypothesisTestedAndRefuted.test: Compared, per parcel, (a) the route's actual zoning source chain on origin/main (03bb424a) read at source, against (b) the probe's own railStates for the same parcel's zoning cells.
dispatchHypothesisTestedAndRefuted.verdict: REFUTED as stated. The failure is not county-keying or county-scoping. It is that the route does not read the record rail AT ALL, for any parcel, in any county. The card's stamp and the route's stamp are different SOURCES, not different county scopes of one source.
dispatchHypothesisTestedAndRefuted.consequence: The fix is a source addition (read the rail the ledger serves), not a re-key or a per-county source loader.

routeZoningChainAtOriginMain: 1. parcel.zoningCode - the live GIS/TxGIO parcel property (blank on all five)
2. baked Tier-1 node-facet snapshot via spineZoningDistrict.resolveSpineZoningWhenGisAbsent -> loadBakedNodeFacetSnapshot (no zoning district on all five)
3. retrieval atom-chain zoningFact.district (gated on a credential, see defect A2)
classA_noZoningStamp.primaryFinding: The route's chain contains NO read of the parcel-record rail. The stamp every one of these parcels is served from is the record rail's zoningDistrict cell ({serve:"record", atomBacked:false}). LDT already has a gated reader for exactly that cell - loadZoningFactForServe (lib/zoningFactServeCutover.ts) - and the facets route the card reads already uses it (routes/brokerageNodeFacets.ts). The drawing route never calls it. The route therefore honest-declines no-zoning-stamp while the ledger stamp is present and readable.

defectA2_credential.finding: The route's two atom-chain call sites resolve the retrieval credential from HAUSKA_RETRIEVAL_API_KEY || RETRIEVAL_API_KEY only. The deployed cortex-api mounts BRIEF_RETRIEVAL_API_KEY (and BRIEF_RETRIEVAL_API_URL), NOT those two names, so both sites return early (if (!key) return null / return false) and the atom-chain branch is dead in production.
defectA2_credential.precedentSameRepo: A sibling lane already found this exact live defect and fixed it, with a regression guard test literally named 'LIVE FINDING regression guard: falls back to BRIEF_RETRIEVAL_API_KEY/URL when neither HAUSKA_RETRIEVAL_API_KEY nor RETRIEVAL_API_KEY is set' (lib/parcelRecordReaderClient.test.ts:114). The fix landed in lib/parcelRecordReaderClient.ts:108-110 and lib/placeCoverageSource.ts:88-90 but was never carried to the buildable-envelope modules.
defectA2_credential.deployEvidence: .github/workflows/cloud-run-deploy.yml mounts BRIEF_RETRIEVAL_API_URL/BRIEF_RETRIEVAL_API_KEY; no HAUSKA_RETRIEVAL_API_KEY or RETRIEVAL_API_KEY is mounted.

classA_noZoningStamp.stopConditionNotMet: The dispatch's stop clause ('if the stamp is genuinely absent where the route reads and present only in a bake, say so and stop') does not apply: the stamp is present in the ledger's record rail, which is the serving path - so this is the 'make it read the stamp the ledger serves' branch.

classB_kyleGeometry.finding: NOT a stamp gap. The route resolved the district (spine/record-side) and emitted a full 4/4 setback table (25/10/15/10, derivePath labelEdges+derive) - then the boolean clip threw: 'geometry validation failed (boolean clip error: parcel-minus-strips difference threw)'. The failing step is the parcel-minus-strips DIFFERENCE in the geometry derive, i.e. the inset/clip, not the parcel ring and not the edge labelling.
classB_kyleGeometry.disposition: Diagnosed and named. Separate root cause from class A; a change to the clip is out of this lane's mission scope (route's zoning read + parcel match). Carried to leave_behind.

classC_noParcel.finding: The route could not match the composed address to a parcel at all (HTTP 404 'No parcel found for this address'), so zoning never runs. This is an address->parcel resolution failure in Caldwell, independent of zoning. Both Caldwell FAIL buckets show it, so the class is 2 parcels, not the 1 the dispatch counted.

fixDesign.scope: Class A only (5 of the dispatch's 7 buckets). One PR, one file set, no merges/deploys/store writes.
fixDesign.approach: Make the drawing route read the stamp the ledger serves: add the parcel-record zoning cell, through the SAME gated serve reader the facets route already uses, into the buildable-envelope zoning resolution; and repair the atom-chain credential resolution so the route's existing atom-chain branch is actually live in production.

changes.change: Add a parcel-record source step calling the existing gated reader loadZoningFactForServe(parcelNodeId): state==='present' -> district (never invented); state==='absent'/'refused' -> null and fall through. Widen SpineZoningSource to 'baked-snapshot' | 'parcel-record' | 'atom-chain' and add a provenance note for the new source.
changes.precedence: record is consulted BEFORE the bake, mirroring the facets route, which applies parcelRecordZoningFact OVER the baked stamp (lib/structuralFactToFacetsWire.ts:265-284). Same parcel -> same source -> same district on card and route.

changes.change: Resolve base URL and key with the BRIEF_RETRIEVAL_API_URL / BRIEF_RETRIEVAL_API_KEY fallback, matching lib/parcelRecordReaderClient.ts:101,108-110 and lib/placeCoverageSource.ts:81,88-90.
Same credential fallback for its own in-module atom-chain read (or delegate to fetchPropertyAtomChain so there is exactly one copy).

honestyInvariants: No district is ever invented: absent and refused record states fall through, they do not synthesise a code.
no-zoning-stamp remains the honest answer when the record, the bake and the atom chain are all empty for a parcel (a parcel with no district anywhere still declines).
The record read honours the cell-serve slate because it goes through loadZoningFactForServe, never a second ungated read path (the ledger-serving-path law).
No new read path, no vocabulary copy, no value-holding cell.

threeQuestionGate.whatExecutes: spineZoningDistrict.resolveSpineZoningWhenGisAbsent (called from routes/brokeragePlaceBuildableEnvelope.ts when parcel.zoningCode is blank) plus the atom-chain fetch in lib/buildableEnvelope/fetchPropertyAtomChain.ts; after the change, the record rail enters through loadZoningFactForServe.
threeQuestionGate.whatTriggersIt: The draw route runs the zoning read only when the live GIS parcel property carries no zoningCode; the atom-chain/record steps are skipped entirely when GIS already has a district.
threeQuestionGate.whatFailsOnDisagreement: Today: the route declines no-zoning-stamp while the card serves a district - the disagreement is silent and only visible in the probe's per-parcel comparison. After the change the two sides read the same record stamp, so a residual disagreement means one side is not reading the record rail (a measurable, named state).
threeQuestionGate.whatBypassesIt: The bake (Tier-1 node-facet snapshot) bypasses the record: it is a separate per-county stamp that the route prefers over the atom chain, and the facets route then overrides with the record. Any surface drawing from its own source instead of the gated reader bypasses the ledger.
